WITH next_job AS (
    SELECT j.id

    FROM automation_jobs j

    WHERE j.job_type = 'sync_github_tasks'

      AND j.status = 'queued'

      AND j.available_at <= NOW()

      AND j.attempts < j.max_attempts

    ORDER BY
        j.available_at,
        j.created_at

    FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED

    LIMIT 1
),

claimed_job AS (
    UPDATE automation_jobs j

    SET
        status = 'processing',
        attempts = j.attempts + 1,
        locked_at = NOW(),
        completed_at = NULL,
        last_error = NULL

    FROM next_job n

    WHERE j.id = n.id

    RETURNING
        j.id,
        j.campaign_id,
        j.campaign_version_id,
        j.approval_id,
        j.status,
        j.attempts,
        j.max_attempts
)

SELECT
    claimed_job.id::TEXT AS job_id,
    claimed_job.status AS job_status,
    claimed_job.attempts,
    claimed_job.max_attempts,

    c.id::TEXT AS campaign_id,
    c.campaign_code,

    cl.company_name,

    pt.id::TEXT AS task_id,
    pt.task_key,
    pt.task_type,
    pt.title,
    pt.description,
    pt.status AS task_status,
    pt.external_task_id,
    pt.external_task_url

FROM claimed_job

JOIN campaigns c
    ON c.id = claimed_job.campaign_id

JOIN clients cl
    ON cl.id = c.client_id

LEFT JOIN production_tasks pt
    ON pt.campaign_id =
       claimed_job.campaign_id

   AND pt.campaign_version_id =
       claimed_job.campaign_version_id

   AND pt.external_task_id IS NULL

ORDER BY pt.created_at;

parameters.query:
UPDATE production_tasks

SET
    external_system = 'github',
    external_task_id = $2::TEXT,
    external_task_url = $3::TEXT,
    status = 'created'

WHERE id = $1::UUID

RETURNING
    id::TEXT AS task_id,
    task_key,
    external_task_id,
    external_task_url,
    status;

WITH completed_job AS (
    UPDATE automation_jobs

    SET
        status = 'completed',
        completed_at = NOW(),
        locked_at = NULL,
        last_error = NULL

    WHERE id = $1::UUID

      AND job_type = 'sync_github_tasks'

      AND status = 'processing'

    RETURNING
        id,
        campaign_id,
        status,
        attempts,
        completed_at
),

write_log AS (
    INSERT INTO automation_logs (
        workflow_name,
        campaign_id,
        level,
        event_type,
        message,
        details
    )

    SELECT
        '09 - GitHub Task Sync Worker',

        completed_job.campaign_id,

        'info',

        'github_tasks_synchronized',

        'Production tasks were synchronized with GitHub Issues.',

        jsonb_build_object(
            'job_id',
                completed_job.id,

            'attempts',
                completed_job.attempts
        )

    FROM completed_job

    RETURNING id
)

SELECT
    id::TEXT AS job_id,
    status AS job_status,
    attempts,
    completed_at

FROM completed_job;
